slide_title: Extending the Range of Mendelian Genetics
original_text: Extending the Range of Mendelian Genetics
explanation: This slide marks the continuation of discussions on extensions of Mendelian genetics, which include multiple alleles, codominance, incomplete dominance, incomplete penetrance, pleiotropy, polygenic inheritance, and sex-linked traits.

questions.q: Which of the following is considered an extension of Mendelian genetics rather than a standard Mendelian trait?
questions.exp: Option C is correct because incomplete dominance deviates from Mendel's simple dominance patterns and is studied as an extension.
